blurb: A `match` arm can never run, because the arms before it already match every value it would match. The usual cause is a wildcard `_` placed before more specific arms: arms are tried in order, so the wildcard takes everything and the rest are dead code, which Bynk refuses rather than let hide a mistake. Put the specific arms first and the wildcard last, or delete the arm. A guarded arm covers nothing, since its guard may fail.
